title: AI-prohibited Django task-board exercise
summary: Novice software engineering students have two hours to implement a Django task board with creation and status-update features. The task permits documentation, videos, and forums but explicitly prohibits ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, and other LLM tools.

sources.title: Exploring LLM Tools Through the Eyes of Industry Experts and Novice Programmers
sources.evidence_quote: At no time is it allowed to use LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, etc.
